entries.title: Suspicious bidding patterns
traces: repeated or rotating winner patterns across comparable tenders
unexpected withdrawal or non-participation patterns among regular bidders
winning bidder later subcontracting to an unsuccessful bidder
material similarities across nominally competing bid documents or metadata
red_flags: bidding pattern warrants independent competition-integrity review
bid-document similarity warrants provenance and authorship checks
verification_questions: Does the pattern persist across comparable tenders after accounting for geography, capacity and market structure?
Can the apparent bid-document similarity be independently verified from lawfully public records or official data?

entries.title: Procurement lifecycle integrity risks
traces: tender requirements unusually narrow relative to the stated need
non-competitive procedure or single-bid outcome requiring contextual review
red_flags: procurement design or outcome warrants contextual integrity review
post-award change or delivery record warrants comparison with contract terms
verification_questions: Is there a documented lawful and operational justification for the procurement design or non-competitive outcome?
Do amendments, delivery records and payments remain consistent with the awarded contract and documented performance?

entries.title: Beneficial ownership opacity
traces: public ownership records do not clearly identify the natural persons exercising ownership or control
material ownership/control information conflicts across authoritative public sources
multi-entity structure requires additional public-record tracing to establish control
red_flags: ownership or control cannot yet be resolved from available public records
material public-record ownership inconsistency requires corroboration
verification_questions: Which natural persons can be established as exercising ownership or control from lawful authoritative records?
Can conflicting ownership information be resolved through independent public sources and dated provenance?
